spotlights.description: Astratide is a web app that aims to explain complex astrological concepts as simply and visually as possible. It is meant for people who don't want to learn the complexities of astrology, but want to get a clear sense of how the planets are affecting them at any given time.

spotlights.tagline: Local-first, code-aware engineering cognition for AI coding agents
spotlights.description: Persistent memory, contextual retrieval, and continuous cognition about your codebase.

spotlights.tagline: Build small guards. Compose them. A lightweight, zero-dependency toolkit for building reusable TypeScript type guards
spotlights.description: is-kit is a lightweight, zero-dependency toolkit for building reusable TypeScript type guards. It's not just a pile of isX helpers: you write small checks, compose them with and / or / not, validate object shapes and collections, and keep TypeScript narrowing natural in regular control flow. Runtime-safe, composable, and ergonomic, without a heavy schema workflow.

spotlights.tagline: Makes your AI coding agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room, so it writes less code
spotlights.description: Ponytail is an open-source skill for AI coding agents. Before writing code, it climbs a ladder of checks: is the feature needed, does the codebase or standard library already do it, would a one-liner work? It keeps validation, error handling, security and accessibility intact. It comes with slash commands for review, repo audits and tracking deferred shortcuts, and installs into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and more.

spotlights.tagline: Describe the video you want. Montage makes it.
spotlights.description: Montage is an experimental AI-powered video production tool that aims to make creating polished videos as simple as describing what you want. Give it your website, tell it what you'd like to make, and refine the result through natural-language feedback. Montage handles the complexity of putting everything together.
